008package paint.shared.validate;
009
010import paint.shared.utils.PaintLogger;
011
012import java.io.File;
013import java.nio.file.Files;
014import java.nio.file.Path;
015import java.util.ArrayList;
016import java.util.Arrays;
017import java.util.Collections;
018import java.util.List;
019
020import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.*;
021
022/**
023 * Central coordinator for validating multiple experiment CSV files within
024 * a PAINT project. Executes specific validators per file type and aggregates
025 * results into a combined {@link ValidationResult}.
026 */
027public final class ValidationHandler {
028
029    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
030    // MAIN VALIDATION ENTRY POINTS
031    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
032
033    /**
034     * Validates a single file type across multiple experiments.
035     *
036     * @param projectPath     the base path of the PAINT project
037     * @param experimentNames list of experiment directories to validate
038     * @param fileName        the file name to validate (e.g., "Experiment Info.csv")
039     * @return accumulated {@link ValidationResult} across all experiments
040     */
041    public static ValidationResult validateExperiments(Path projectPath,
042                                                       List<String> experimentNames,
043                                                       String fileName) {
044        return validateExperiments(projectPath, experimentNames, Collections.singletonList(fileName));
045    }
046
047    /**
048     * Validates one or more specified files across multiple experiments.
049     *
050     * @param projectPath     the base path of the PAINT project
051     * @param experimentNames list of experiment directories to validate
052     * @param fileNames       list of CSV file names to validate
053     * @return {@link ValidationResult} with accumulated validation issues
054     */
055    public static ValidationResult validateExperiments(Path projectPath,
056                                                       List<String> experimentNames,
057                                                       List<String> fileNames) {
058
059        List<String>     report    = new ArrayList<>();
060        ValidationResult overall   = new ValidationResult();
061
062        for (String expName : experimentNames) {
063            Path expDir = projectPath.resolve(expName);
064
065            if (!Files.isDirectory(expDir)) {
066                String msg = "[" + expName + "] - Directory - Missing experiment directory: " + expDir;
067                overall.addError(msg);
068                report.add(msg);
069                continue;
070            }
071
072            PaintLogger.infof("   Validating experiment: %s", expName);
073
074            for (String fileName : fileNames) {
075                Path filePath = expDir.resolve(fileName);
076
077                if (!Files.exists(filePath)) {
078                    String msg = "[" + expName + "] - " + fileName + " - Missing file";
079                    overall.addError(msg);
080                    report.add(msg);
081                    continue;
082                }
083
084                ValidationResult res = runValidator(fileName, filePath.toFile());
085
086                // Errors
087                for (String err : res.getErrors()) {
088                    String msg = formatMessage(expName, fileName, err);
089                    overall.addError(msg);
090                    report.add(msg);
091                }
092
093                // Warnings
094                for (String warn : res.getWarnings()) {
095                    String msg = formatMessage(expName, fileName, warn);
096                    overall.addWarning(msg);
097                    report.add(msg);
098                }
099            }
100        }
101
102        PaintLogger.blankline();
103
104        if (!report.isEmpty()) {
105            overall.setReport(String.join("\n", report));
106        }
107
108        return overall;
109    }
110
111    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
112    // VALIDATOR ROUTING LOGIC
113    // ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
114
115    /**
116     * Routes validation based on a file name pattern to the appropriate validator.
117     *
118     * @param fileName        the CSV file name
119     * @param file            the {@link File} object to validate
120     * @return a {@link ValidationResult} containing file-specific validation output
121     */
122    private static ValidationResult runValidator(String fileName, File file) {
123        String lower = fileName.toLowerCase();
124        if (lower.contains("experiment")) {
125            return new ExperimentInfoValidator().validateWithConsistency(file);
126        } else if (lower.contains("recording")) {
127            return new RecordingsValidator().validateWithConsistency(file);
128        } else if (lower.contains("track")) {
129            return new TracksValidator().validate(file);
130        } else if (lower.contains("square")) {
131            return new SquaresValidator().validate(file);
132        } else {
133            ValidationResult res = new ValidationResult();
134            res.addError("Unknown file: " + fileName);
135            return res;
136        }
137    }
138
139    /**
140     * Formats a validation message consistently for inclusion in the summary report.
141     */
142    private static String formatMessage(String expName, String fileName, String err) {
143        String flattened = err.replace("\n", " ").replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
144
145        if (flattened.startsWith("[" + expName + "]")) {
146            return "[" + expName + "] - " + fileName + " - "
147                    + flattened.substring(flattened.indexOf("]") + 1).trim();
148        }
149        return "[" + expName + "] - " + fileName + " - " + flattened;
150    }
151
152
153}
